 EPFO has explained the five-step online process to correct errors in PF records through the Joint Declaration facility 
 Ayush Mishra 
 November 10, 2026 / 13:35 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 EPFO EPFO shares a 5-step process to correct EPF records online.
 Members can use the Joint Declaration facility on the portal.
 Correct details help avoid delays in withdrawals and claims.

 in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan
 Register for FREE Webinar Register for FREE 
 The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation ( EPFO ) has shared a five-step process for members to correct incorrect details in their provident fund records. Members can use the Joint Declaration facility on the EPFO Member Portal to submit correction requests along with supporting documents.
 In a post on its official social media handle, the retirement fund body explained a five-step process that members can follow to request corrections in their account details.
 The facility is useful for employees who find discrepancies in their personal or employment information recorded in their EPF accounts. Incorrect details can create complications when members apply for provident fund withdrawals, transfer their accumulated balance or seek settlement of claims.
 How to correct incorrect details in your EPF account online 
 According to the process shared by EPFO, members can follow these five steps:

 Step 1: Log in to the EPFO Member Portal 
 Visit the EPFO Unified Member Portal and log in using your UAN and password.
 Step 2: Click on the Joint Declaration facility 
 After logging in, select the Joint Declaration facility available on the member portal. This facility allows members to submit requests for corrections in their EPF records.
 Step 3: Select the details you want to correct 
 Identify the information that has been incorrectly recorded in your EPF account and select the relevant details for correction.
 Step 4: Enter the correct information and upload supporting documents 
 Fill in the correct information in the designated fields. Upload the required supporting documents to establish the accuracy of the details being submitted.
 Step 5: Submit your request 
 Review the information and documents uploaded before submitting the correction request. Once submitted, the request will be taken up for verification and processing.
 Members should check their EPF records periodically and ensure that the information matches their official documents. Correct details can help avoid discrepancies and delays when accessing provident fund services.
 Services on WhatsApp 
 EPFO subscribers can also use its authenticated WhatsApp channel to check their PF balance, view their last five transactions and access their passbook. The service will also provide personalised assistance to members in understanding the eligibility conditions under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY).
